studies.title: Coringa / Godavari delta, Andhra Pradesh
studies.question: Do surface-water and vegetation signals in the Coringa mangrove creeks differ between seasonally matched 2020 and 2025 observations, and how far can a masked NDVI difference be trusted at this tidal site?
phenomena: surface water extent in tidal creeks

aoi.boundary_source: Manually placed over the mangrove/creek complex of Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary south of Kakinada; not the official sanctuary boundary.

limitations: Tidal stage and turbidity are uncontrolled confounders.

studies.title: Purepu supraglacial-lake drainage, Rasuwa (8 July 2025)
studies.event_mechanism: rapid discharge of a supraglacial lake on the Purepu Glacier
studies.question: Are usable Sentinel-2 observations available before and after 8 July 2025 over the Purepu lake source area, and what does cloud cover permit?

aoi.boundary_source: Placed from published NDRRMA situation-report context; centre is approximate and has not been snapped to a verified lake shoreline.

limitations: Monsoon cloud; terrain shadow; approximate AOI centre.
No volume or dam-failure inference from area alone.

studies.title: Langtang Lirung rock-ice collapse, Rasuwa (26 August 2026)
studies.event_mechanism: rock-and-ice collapse and cascading debris-laden flood, explicitly not a conventional glacial lake outburst
studies.question: Are usable Sentinel-2 observations available before and after 26 August 2026 around the high source zone, and where does optical visibility fail?

aoi.boundary_source: Centred on the Langtang Lirung massif from published ICIMOD/ESA context; exact detachment scar not verified at M0.

limitations: Heavy monsoon cloud; snow/shadow confusion; optical only.
InSAR deformation is external literature, not reproduced here.

studies.title: Kathmandu Valley urban pilot, Nepal
studies.question: Are matched-season Sentinel-2 pairs available over a bounded inner-city pilot, and does bare soil / construction confusion threaten a built-up signal?

aoi.kind: small bounded pilot window inside the urban core
aoi.boundary_source: Manually placed; not a municipal boundary.

limitations: Bare soil, construction sites and dry riverbeds mimic built-up spectra.
